title: Bank of America Workplace Benefits® Recognized by JD Power for Outstanding Client Service
summary: The Bank of America Retirement & Benefits Contact Center has been recognized by JD Power for “An Outstanding Customer Service Experience” for phone support for the 22nd consecutive year.
body_markdown:
October 28, 2026 at 12:00 PM Eastern


#


Bank of America Workplace Benefits® Recognized by JD Power for Outstanding Client Service


## Key points


- JD Power recognizes Bank of America’s Retirement & Benefits Contact Center for delivering “An Outstanding Customer Service Experience.”
- Recognition reflects decades of sustained commitment to providing best-in-class client service and helping clients navigate retirement and benefits decisions.


## Key points


NEW YORK, New York


N.Y.


– The Bank of America Retirement & Benefits Contact Center has been recognized by J D


JD


Power for “An Outstanding Customer Service Experience” for phone support for the 22nd consecutive year.


The contact center serves[Bank of America Workplace Benefits®](https://business.bofa.com/en-us/content/workplace-benefits/solutions-and-services.html?utm_source=wbpartnerships&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=mb2026&utm_content=HRBrew) clients with benefit-plan services for employee four oh one k


401(k)


, defined benefit, deferred compensation, equity award and health savings account programs. To earn certification, a contact center must successfully complete an audit and exceed customer satisfaction benchmarks based on J D


JD


Power's cross-industry customer satisfaction research.


*“Service is central to how we build trust and deliver a differentiated client experience,”* said **Stacy Bucchere, Managing Director of Workplace Benefits at Bank of America** . *“By combining deep expertise with high-quality support, our teams empower plan participants to make confident, well-informed decisions about their benefits and retirement future.”*


Workplace Benefits also went through a rigorous site Evaluation Assessment, which it was compliant with, demonstrating the operational precision behind its client support.


*“Achieving certification another year reflects our dedication to operational excellence,”* said **John Quinn, Managing Director of Workplace Benefits at Bank of America** . *“We apply this level of rigor to our client service and product portfolio to deliver a truly outstanding participant experience.”*


This certification highlights the partnership between Bank of America Workplace Benefits and Merrill Wealth Management Client Care, and their shared focus on delivering consistent, quality service.


*"Twenty-two consecutive years of recognition does not happen by accident. It is the result of a team that shows up for every caller, every day, with the same care and attention,"* said **Denise Buchanan, head of Wealth Management Client Care** . *"Meeting the operational best-practices assessment reflects the high standard this team holds itself to. I could not be prouder of their work and their commitment to the clients we serve."*


The ranking or ratings shown here may not be representative of all client experiences because they reflect an average or sampling of the client experiences. The rankings or ratings are not indicative of any future performance or investment outcome.


## Frequently asked questions


### Question: What types of services are available to Bank of America Workplace Benefits clients?


**Answer:** Bank of America Workplace Benefits is committed to providing support for its clients’ employees, including an[award-winning digital experience](https://www.jdpower.com/business/press-releases/2026-u-s-retirement-plan-digital-experience-study/) available through the Bank of America mobile app and website, live virtual support through contact centers, and in-person guidance at Bank of America financial centers.


### Question: What Workplace Benefits solutions and services do Bank of America and Merrill offer clients?


**Answer:** Through retirement and benefit plans\[1\] , health benefit accounts\[2\] , employee banking solutions\[2\] , stock plan services\[1\] and more, seamlessly integrated across its full set of financial capabilities, employees have a more holistic view of their financial lives, so they get the benefits most relevant to what they need today and aligned with their goals for tomorrow.
